{"schema_version":1,"triplet_id":"ft_mp_parse_787468773c9f","entrypoint":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","input_strategy":{"description":"Decode the fuzz input as a bounded sequence of MP frames. Each frame is 8-byte header (magic 'M','P', version 1, opcode, little-endian payload_length, little-endian checksum) followed by payload bytes. The harness assembles each frame from fuzz bytes, repairs payload_length and checksum, and calls mp_parse once per frame against a single mp_context kept alive across the whole iteration.","data_identifier":"data","size_identifier":"size","bounded_steps":32,"notes":["bounded_steps=32 matches the contract command_loop.max_steps and input_model.bounded_steps.","Payload bytes are taken from the fuzz input starting at frame.payload_offset; they are never filled with constants.","payload_length and checksum are computed by the harness while assembling each frame, not read from fuzz bytes.","mp_context is created once per LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput call and destroyed once at the end, never per frame."]},"state_objects":[{"name":"ctx","type":"mp_context","initialization":"mp_init(&ctx) at the start of LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput; destroyed via mp_destroy(&ctx) after the frame loop."}],"call_sequence":[{"function":"mp_init","roles":["HPF"],"purpose":"Initialize the mp_context once per iteration so state persists across all frames decoded from this fuzz input.","arguments":["&ctx"],"uses_fuzzer_data":false,"uses_fuzzer_size":false,"outputs":["ctx"],"conditions":["once per LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput call"]},{"function":"mp_parse","roles":["ISF","PRF"],"purpose":"Parse one assembled MP frame; called once per decoded frame within the bounded loop, using the same ctx across frames so MP_STORE/MP_RELEASE/MP_USE state carries over.","arguments":["&ctx","frame_bytes","frame_len"],"uses_fuzzer_data":true,"uses_fuzzer_size":true,"outputs":["return status"],"conditions":["frame_len >= MP_HEADER_SIZE","payload_length == frame_len - MP_HEADER_SIZE","payload_length <= MP_MAX_PAYLOAD","checksum matches mp_checksum(payload, payload_length)","magic0=='M' && magic1=='P' && version==1"]}],"cleanup_sequence":[{"function":"mp_destroy","purpose":"Release any state held by ctx (including ctx->saved when ctx->owns_saved is set) after all frames have been processed.","arguments":["&ctx"],"after":["mp_parse"]}],"constraints":["Do not redefine project APIs; use only mp_init, mp_parse, mp_destroy, and the declared mp_context type.","mp_parse must be called with both fuzzer data and fuzzer size bound to its (data, size) parameters.","The mp_context must be created once per iteration and destroyed once per iteration, after the frame loop.","payload_length and checksum fields must be written by the harness during frame assembly, never taken from raw fuzz bytes.","Payload bytes at offsets [payload_offset, payload_offset+payload_length) must come from the fuzz input.","Frame loop must be bounded by input_strategy.bounded_steps (32).","Stateful opcodes MP_STORE, MP_USE, MP_RELEASE must be reachable in order within the same ctx lifetime."],"notes":["mp_parse is both ISF and PRF; it appears once in call_sequence and its cleanup responsibility is handled by mp_destroy in cleanup_sequence.","mp_destroy is HPF and appears only in cleanup_sequence, after all mp_parse calls.","No protocol contract fields are paraphrased; protocol_contract_bindings mirrors the supplied contract verbatim."],"protocol_contract_bindings":{"context":{"destroy":"mp_destroy","init":"mp_init","lifetime":"per_iteration","type":"mp_context"},"frame":{"fields":[{"name":"magic0","offset":0,"role":"magic","value":"'M'","width":1},{"name":"magic1","offset":1,"role":"magic","value":"'P'","width":1},{"name":"version","offset":2,"role":"version","value":"1","width":1},{"name":"opcode","offset":3,"role":"opcode","width":1},{"endianness":"little_endian","name":"payload_length","offset":4,"role":"payload_length","width":2},{"endianness":"little_endian","name":"checksum","offset":6,"role":"checksum","width":2},{"name":"payload","offset":8,"role":"payload","width":"payload_length"}],"header_size":8,"max_payload":64,"max_payload_symbol":"MP_MAX_PAYLOAD","payload_offset":8},"helpers":["le16","mp_checksum","mp_destroy","mp_init","mp_parse"],"input_model":{"bounded_multi_frame":true,"bounded_steps":32,"bounded_steps_source":"engineering_choice","payload_fuzzer_controlled":true,"repair_checksum":true,"repair_length":true},"stateful_operations":["MP_RELEASE","MP_STORE","MP_USE"]}}
